meta.title: Nadiia Lezhanska | Frontend Developer
meta.description: Check out my portfolio: frontend projects built with React, Next.js and Angular.

hero.intro: I’m Nadiia, a frontend developer. I like clean code, fewer dependencies and interfaces that feel obvious to use.

frontend.title: Frontend development
frontend.text: I build web applications with React, Next.js, Angular and TypeScript, with clean code and minimal dependencies.

responsive.title: Responsive and accessible UI
responsive.text: I make interfaces that work smoothly on desktop, tablet and mobile, with user-friendly design.

testing.title: Testing and documentation
testing.text: I write component and e2e tests (Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress) and document components in Storybook.

skills.title: Skills & tools
skills.text: The skills, tools and technologies I use:

salesAssistant.title: Sales Assistant
salesAssistant.text: An online store with an AI chat assistant for store employees. An internal training project at Columbus.

items.assistant: Sales Assistant: an AI chat assistant that helps store employees recommend products to customers. I built the frontend: voice recognition (Web Speech API), the chat interface with keyword tags and product grid, session history with restored scroll position, loading and error states.
items.store: Online store (commercetools): the product page, the cart (commercetools + Context API + useActionState + Server Actions), an anonymous cart for guests that merges with the customer cart after sign-in, and a multi-step checkout.

houseStaff.title: House Staff
houseStaff.text: An e-commerce storefront with a cart and wishlist for guests and signed-in users, Google sign-in and order placement through a Node/Express REST API. Responsive UI with code splitting, component tests and Storybook documentation.

contact.title: I'm open to new job opportunities and interesting projects.
